scope: Historical signed KMD hardware initialization comparison. Static evidence only, with no additional physical acceptance round. Addresses are GPU BAR-relative byte offsets.

comparison.decision: Keep the historical restart open. Station timeout alignment controls one experimental variable; no causal conclusion.

criteria: Resolve the register through the actual function and version-matched register header.
Trace KMD callers, computed addresses, generated constants, tables and firmware before asserting a missing write.
Separate explicit upstream rationale from inferred effects. Windows behavior without independent evidence is 待实机验证. Exclude Horizon-only and winsys-specific workarounds.

priv_station_timeout.call_phase: After ZCULL initialization and before GR FIFO/semaphore access enable in gk20a_init_gr_setup_hw.
priv_station_timeout.write: Both receive the full word 0x800. The default 0x400 is documented in the upstream comment, not measured on boot 91476.
priv_station_timeout.upstream_reason: NVIDIA bug 1340570. The stated purpose is to avoid a possible operation failure at high GPC clock rates.
priv_station_timeout.windows_evidence: Neither historical KMD nor candidate parent implements the two indexed station writes. Priv-ring enable and FECS station error reads use different offsets. Checked platform/core/windows, the compiled Horizon encoder, both byte offsets and array base addresses, and the non-context and context register lists of NETB 5b285e5de99b935c2619e54b1656b8a2f271ba845e80952faadfd09960d6eea3 (176 and 451 entries). Firmware internals and signed historical machine code were not individually disassembled.
priv_station_timeout.impact: Upstream purpose documented. Actual Windows board effect and any relation to fault 91557: 待实机验证.

focus.ptimer: GM20B platform supplies 19.2 MHz (os/linux/platform_gk20a_tegra.c:906). include/nvgpu/ptimer.h converts in software against 31.25 MHz. gk20a_read_ptimer samples high/low/high; the read has no calibration write. The FIFO uses a separately scaled timeout at 0x2a0c. The default TSG timeslice of 128 with shift 3 is present in the KMD runlist. Historical DxgkDdiCalibrateGpuClock returns STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED; that is a distinct Windows API contract.
focus.semaphore: gk20a_channel_abort_clean_up dispatches channel_sync_semaphore_set_min_eq_max to nvgpu_semaphore_reset (common/fifo/channel.c:189; common/sync/channel_sync.c:542; common/semaphore.c:582). It fast-forwards a mapped memory word to next_value and wakes waiters only when required. The Tegra syncpoint backend is a separate branch. Neither operation is a universal physical GPU register write. Windows reset_backend.c isolates hardware, detaches work, zeros the private command store and reconstructs the channel. No inference that Windows may complete unretired work.
focus.environment: Treat NVIDIA secure-firmware access restrictions according to the actual boot and privilege mode. Horizon-only FECS write constraints or winsys workarounds are outside the native KMD absence list.

coverage: Reviewed rows only. Duplicate aliases and IRQ/resume-only entries are distinguished. Conditional GR firmware, secure PMU/ACR and dynamically computed addresses require matching execution context. No completeness claim from literal search.

review_basis.address_authority: On the complete OE4T patches-rel-36 tree at 21d928824dc7ca3dc17603a53b11edc6641ace2d the two gm20b station headers retain the address formulas, but the legacy function and its two-write call are absent by name. The pinned T210 implementation and both matching T210 headers supply the values, indices and rationale. Other MMIO entries use their own register headers.
review_basis.independent_review: Matched named writes and header offsets; checked what the actual NETB tables replay by value and geometry. NETB is a retained matching hash from the historical rollback package. The opaque microcode itself is outside this static-side audit.
review_basis.read_coalescing_correction: NETB region 5 executes {addr, index, value} records. For 0x419a3c its stored value is 0x181e, including both bits 2 and 4. gk20a_init_gr_setup_hw calls gm20a_gr_disable_rd_coalesce before sw_ctx_load, so the upstream transient field clear is distinct from the final replayed value. A persistent clear after replay would introduce an unverified policy.

gating_tables.windows_policy: Upstream conditionally selects prod or disable values. KMD uses force-run in selected blocks. No assumption that an omitted profile is a correctness bug, or that a gating state can be changed without matching Windows power/IRQ ownership. Effect: 待实机验证.

transition_difference.kmd: platform/t214_clock.c sets OUT during startup. The historical bypass/relock path lacks the two identical intermediate vcodiv=2 writes when the old or new PL is below 2. This is a sequence difference.
transition_difference.documented_reason: Upstream explains that this transition can glitch and intentionally doubles the write to engage the linear divider. Windows high-load reboot and voltage effects are 待实机验证.

exclusions.protected_firmware: Horizon or winsys workarounds and its FECS access restrictions are excluded as environmental differences. Secure boot and supported native PMU/ACR flows should be checked on their own terms.
exclusions.compressed_resources: No native uncompressed-only KMD equivalent is required for Linux comptag backing store or ZBC compression programming.
exclusions.irq_ownership: Linux stall IRQ routing, interrupt-time W1C acknowledgements and per-TSG recovery are not unconditional cold-start writes. Deliberately retained WDDM completion/abort and interrupt ownership rules.
exclusions.retained_coverage_limit: All upstream functions and values in admitted rows are source-backed. Indirect firmware execution and physical reset defaults remain unresolved; the broad generated candidate-site count is not a missing-write count.

coverage_by_component.MC/PRIV/BUS: Historical station writes admitted. Stall and nonstall masks have different owners on Windows. The unconditional WDDM W1C of pending interrupts during initialization differs from an interrupt-time acknowledgement.
coverage_by_component.FB/MMU/LTC: Compared active LTC count, TLB/flush, and FB/GPC debug state. Compression/comptag allocation, protected-region setup and IRQ-only operations are conditional.
coverage_by_component.FIFO/PBDMA/CE2: Compared timeout, status clears, enable masks, runlist, channel and CE2 initialization across core/execute.c and platform/t214_frontend.c. The local abort model does not synthesize a Linux per-TSG MMU fault.
coverage_by_component.GR: Compared NETB firmware replay, saved configuration, exception masks, pre-replay coalescing and station timeout placement. Opaque FECS/GPCCS firmware execution remains unverified.
coverage_by_component.ACR/PMU: The native secure ACR/WPR and polling bootstrap are separate from Linux ELPG and runtime PMU interrupt/queue service. PMU firmware contents and hardware defaults remain open.
coverage_by_component.Clocks/THERM: Compared clock profiles and the conditional old/new PL transition with the KMD C1 NA path. SLCG/BLCG profile presence does not establish an observed on-board power or thermal effect.
coverage_by_component.PTIMER/semaphore: Register reads, software conversion, mapped semaphore memory and the abort/wake path are separated from cold initialization and IRQ-only writes.

local_timeout_candidate.scope: Single source change to the production graphics setup. Full word 0x800 to SYS then GPC immediately after ZCULL, before the initial graphics context stream and publication of boot-ready state. The copy-only path does not acquire this graphics state. Windows enables GR FIFO access earlier during boot, so the global sequence is not identical. Cold restart calls TgGpuStartHardware again.
local_timeout_candidate.test: Built and linked production ARM64 display KMD locally. Host model ran source-order and negative/ownership checks, full graphics bring-up, and GR context replay with NETB_img.bin. The final real-NETB model passed after correcting a premature ZCULL ordering assumption in an intermediate test.
local_timeout_candidate.hardware: No deployment or hardware register readback in this audit. No promotion and no attribution of the historical reboot.

combined_hardware.status: Qualified native handheld desktop. The legacy 91476 scene and a physical PL=1 high-frequency transition were not run in this acceptance.
